objectives.text: Follow the lantern trail into Briarwood Forest.
Meet Historian Lyra at the Forest Edge campsite.
Investigate the broken bridge at the stream.
Gather bridge materials at the worksite (0/3).
Repair the old bridge across the stream.
Read the three ancient forest inscriptions (0/3).
Align the three mirrors in Mirror Grove.
Activate the First Ancient Beacon at the shrine.
Listen to Elena's echo at the First Beacon.
Speak with Lyra at the shrine to chart Floodmill.

lyra.speaker: HISTORIAN LYRA
before_entry: Hold on, traveler—check the Forest Edge trail waystone first so you get your bearings in this mist.
meet_lyra: LYRA: "You came from Bellhaven, didn't you?"   AREN: "How could you know?"
LYRA: "Because the forest has been whispering that name since the thirteenth toll."
I'm Lyra—a traveling historian. Sister Elara tends Bellhaven's temple ledgers, while I walk the wilds chasing places every modern map conveniently forgot.
Your mother Elena camped by this very hearth months ago. Her trail leads north across the stream, except the Old Bridge is down. Let's inspect the crossing together.
bridge_search: Once we've seen the collapsed span, check the abandoned carpenter's worksite east of Whispering Fork. We'll need two sound oak planks, a coil of hemp rope, and whatever plan the builder left behind.
bridge_ready: Two planks and a rope coil—classic timber engineering. Follow the worksite ledger in order: LEFT BEAM, then RIGHT PLANK, then ROPE LASHING.
north_exploration: Notice these sunken foundations, Aren? Nobody in Bellhaven remembers a village named Oakhaven, yet its paving stones match Elena's oldest sketches.
To lower the shrine's light barrier in Mirror Grove, read all three ancient stone inscriptions nearby—West, Center, and East—for the mirror angles.
mirror_ready: All three carved verses match Elena's field notes! Step up to the Mirror Grove dais and align WEST to DAWN, CENTER to ZENITH, and EAST to DUSK.
beacon_ready: The mirror light broke the barrier! Approach the First Ancient Beacon at the northern sanctuary and wake its core.
echo_ready: Look at the crystal—it's humming with stored memory! Touch the First Ancient Beacon again to hear what Elena left behind.
finale: Did you hear her voice, Aren? "There are truths the bell was built to silence." Whatever the Great Bell hides, it erased whole towns like this one.
And look inside the beacon plinth—Elena etched a brass hydro-compass bearing pointing southeast toward Floodmill Wetlands.
Two beacons remain, mapmaker. Ready your satchel when we march for the Drowned Village—I wouldn't miss the next chapter for all the ink in Ashvale.
completed: The First Ancient Beacon shines steady over Briarwood. Whenever Chapter 2 begins, that southeast gate opens toward Floodmill Wetlands.

forest_entry: Cool pine resin replaces Bellhaven's coal smoke as lantern-lit roots curve beneath an emerald canopy.
Ahead by a flickering trailhead campfire waits a historian poring over weathered brass charts—and footprints older than the village.
broken_bridge_inspect: The Old Bridge's center span has dropped into the rushing turquoise stream, snapping its western beams.
Across the Whispering Fork signpost, timber stacks mark an abandoned carpenter's worksite east of here—likely holding the oak planks, rope, and repair ledger we need.
worksite_clue: CARPENTER'S LEDGER: "Span repair order—Step 1: Set the sturdy LEFT BEAM. Step 2: Lay the RIGHT PLANK deck. Step 3: Bind fast with ROPE LASHING."
The inked diagram confirms every piece is still lying nearby among the timber stacks.
inscription_west: WEATHERED MONOLITH (WEST): "Before the Great Bell rang in Ashvale, Oakhaven kept dawn watch by beacon fire—till one solstice scrubbed our roofs from every parchment."
CARVED KEYSTONE NOTE: "First glass catches morning light—turn the WEST MIRROR toward DAWN."
inscription_center: MOSSY ARCHSTONE (CENTER): "Travelers forget the names of sisters and bridges after curfew; only etched stone remembers what the storm-bell demands in payment."
CARVED KEYSTONE NOTE: "Noon ray rises straight overhead—set the CENTER MIRROR toward ZENITH."
inscription_east: SHATTERED FOUNTAIN STELE (EAST): "Elena's chalk sits beside ancient runes: 'Three beacons share one dawn. Do not trust the twelfth chime alone.'"
CARVED KEYSTONE NOTE: "Last glass reflects twilight gold—angle the EAST MIRROR toward DUSK."
beacon_activation: Golden-cyan fire climbs the spiral stone pillar as the First Ancient Beacon locks into resonance with the Mirror Grove rays.
Deep within the crystal heart, a translucent golden ripple shimmers—awaiting Aren's touch to speak Elena's stored memory.
elena_recording: ELENA'S ECHO: "If you found this, Aren, then the first beacon still remembers."
ELENA'S ECHO: "There are truths the bell was built to silence. Find the others."
The luminous memory dissolves into warm sparks, leaving a hydro-compass bearing pointing southeast toward Floodmill. Speak with Lyra by the shrine.
ruined_camp_note: RUINED SURVEY CAMP: An overturned inkwell, two tin mugs, and a torn vellum strip stamped with both Elena's compass and Lyra's archive seal.
LYRA'S MARGINALIA: "Oakhaven vanished the same winter Bellhaven hung the Great Bell. Someone wanted the beacons forgotten."
